notes:
• Bullet and numbered lists: wrapped lines now line up under the text like in
  Figma (a real hanging indent, measured from Figma) instead of jumping back
  to the left edge. Needs After Effects 2024 (24.3) or newer.
• Long text boxes (e.g. safety information) sit exactly where they are in
  Figma – no more first letters cut off at the frame edge.
• Soft line breaks (Shift+Enter in Figma) stay soft line breaks, and pasted
  text with Windows line endings no longer gets extra blank lines (which
  could push the last line out of its frame).
